source_frame_contract.upstream_terminal_rule: One unpaginated SPARQL JSON response was preserved. No prospective request-intent, redirect, header, retry, provider-version, or complete-federation terminal receipt exists for that earlier request.
source_frame_contract.canonicalization_rule: Decode each Special:FilePath suffix with UTF-8 percent-decoding, replace underscores by spaces, sort by normalized painter ID then numeric item QID then case-folded filename, reject duplicate item-file pairs, and preserve every image row for later physical-work reconciliation.
source_frame_contract.deduplication_rule: No physical-work or capture deduplication occurs in this audit. Distinct Wikidata item IDs and Commons filenames are retained separately; repeated images for one item remain rows.
source_frame_contract.consequence: This run may establish current entity/file rights-marker and reported-geometry attrition for the fixed seed only. It cannot prove an exhaustive current source census, download an image, admit a work, or satisfy the terminal R0 source-frame gate. R2 is a new authorization after the first census correctly terminated on a previously unsupported but valid MediaWiki language-fallback term representation.

prior_terminal_census.failure_cause: The parser rejected a valid MediaWiki languagefallback label whose source language was en and whose requested target was explicitly recorded as for-language=fr.
prior_terminal_census.retry_rule: Preserve the terminal census unchanged; repair only the general parser contract; prepare a complete new 165-request census with a new ID, new outputs, new freeze, and new authorization. Do not splice or reuse the four earlier successes.

request_contract.user_agent: latent-art-bench/0.1 painter-feature-generation-v1 fixed-seed metadata audit r2; not complete R0 census (+https://github.com/isingmodel/latent-art-bench)
request_contract.terminal_rule: HTTP 200 plus exact parser-complete stage schema, explicit provider timestamp/host, exact requested-member coverage, no redirect or title normalization, no continuation, and an exact P18 item-file link is success. Listed transport/HTTP/API failures consume a persisted attempt and may retry only inside the frozen lifetime cap. A valid integer or timezone-aware HTTP-date Retry-After is honored through the frozen 30-second ceiling; a malformed or longer value, or a crash after an attempt start, terminates this census and requires a newly authorized census ID. Every other HTTP/API/schema failure is terminal without fallback. MediaWiki languagefallback terms are accepted only when the returned for-language exactly names the requested term-map key.

screening_contract.authority_rule: Wikidata and Commons remain discovery/delivery evidence. No row is admitted until an authoritative holding or catalogue record independently confirms exact attribution, oil on canvas, work identity, and the media reuse basis.
